assessment: This paper on the regulation of microtubule dynamics during C. elegans meiosis presents important findings that will be of interest to scientists in the broad field of microtubule function in both mitosis and meiosis. The experiments are beautifully conducted and presented and support the conclusions of the paper in a compelling manner. The results are interesting and add to our understanding of the control of microtubule dynamics at the kinetochore and its functional consequences for meiosis.
